data.name: PFKFB3
data.description: 6-phosphofructo-2-kinase/fructose-2,6-bisphosphatase 3, a rate-limiting glycolytic regulator controlled downstream of mTORC2.
data.description_beginner: A control enzyme for glycolysis, the fast way cells burn sugar. It sets the pace of that pathway, and mTORC2 sits upstream of it deciding how much of it the cell makes.
